Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!
Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.
We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.
It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.
Kraken Customer
 
What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.
 
Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.
 
We have been licensing Kraken for over 4 years now, transforming businesses by not only moving their customer base to our Kraken platform but also changing their operating model & ways of working. Throughout this time our team has been at the forefront of industry leading migrations whilst setting a new standard for what business transformation can look like. 
 
🏠 Where you'll fit in:
 
You will be joining the client delivery team with Kraken working to support European clients through their technology transformation journeys, supporting long term migration projects.
 The Client Delivery Lead has direct responsibility managing a tech domain (billing, finance, comms...) for our client projects. This is either migrating onto our Kraken platform or managing long term technology requirements. They need to work in partnership with the technology and operational teams at Kraken as well as the client to deliver results for our client’s project or business needs. 
 
The Client Delivery Lead has to really understand how Kraken works, understand problems or requests raised by the client and refine solutions in the best way to leverage existing and new capability. They will bring technology, people and processes together to innovate improvements for our clients. You will also support the client in adapting to ways of working that are aligned to Kraken’s development style. You will work closely with Kraken’s product managers and developers to request development needs and act as a link to the client.
🚀 What you'll own:
• 
You will be managing the relationship with client counterparts (often product owners and business owners)
• 
You will be the first point of contact for tech development and the escalation and resolution point with customers for specific domain/product issues
• 
Being the knowledge base of how Kraken works and how we deliver Kraken Platform
• 
Triaging incoming requests and communicating client priorities internally. 
• 
Summarising and articulating client needs, considerations, timelines internally to enable the ongoing development of the Kraken platform.
• 
Supporting the engineering team to deliver product features
• 
Challenging the client to think differently about tech development, having full belief in the continuous iteration and deployment approach we have.
 
This is a hands-on, individual contributor position. The role is European based and your projects could be run from any country, travel is expected as part of this role.
 
We are a flat and agile organisation and plan to remain this way. We are looking for open minded individuals who are comfortable with ambiguity and an ever changing environment. To thrive here you must be a self-starter and willing to roll your sleeves up to solve any problem, constantly flexing outside of your typical job role to drive progress for our clients and organisation.
You must be  committed to the Kraken way of delivering tech based on simplicity, client benefit and efficiency while bringing stakeholders through a journey of change. 
 
You must be willing to challenge beliefs, have the ability to see through multiple viewpoints and, if needed, reach beyond your remit to support the client. 
 
We are building a Kraken for everyone, a universal platform where there is greater benefit in sharing development to enable the green energy transition. Pioneers in this space, we are excited about how Kraken can change the lives of our customers and convinced that Kraken is the best answer, not only for efficiency but as a tool to tackle the climate crisis. If you believe this too then Kraken Tech is the right place for you.

In this position you will be laser focused on satisfying our customer’s needs. We are looking for people with strong problem solving skills and a super positive solutions oriented mindset. Experience in the energy sector is a plus. We welcome candidates from a range of backgrounds, including accounting, finance, billing, payments, and fintech.

Headquarters: SANTA ANA, CA
 
URL: https://acestainless.com

Ecommerce and Digital Marketing Manager

ACE STAINLESS SUPPLY

Full-time | Fully remote | Worldwide
$10,000–$25,000 USD annually, depending on experience
Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–4:30 PM Pacific Time

Build a website that earns its place in the business

Help us turn a ready product catalog into a working carbon steel storefront—and turn our digital marketing into qualified inquiries, orders, and repeat customers.

ACE Stainless Supply distributes stainless steel pipe, valves, fittings, bar, and sheet, serving customers through our Santa Ana, California, and Caldwell, Idaho, operations. We are expanding our digital business with AceCarbonSteel.com, and we want someone who can help build it, launch it, and grow it.

You will report to Erica Biscocho, Director of E-Commerce and Digital Operations. You will work alongside Hafsa in e-commerce and our marketing team, coordinate product information with Funmi, and partner with sales and our technical providers. This is a hands-on role: you will create content, make website improvements, run campaigns, and move launch work through to completion.

Your first major deliverable

Launch design of AceCarbonSteel.com as an operational customer-facing website on January 1, 2027.

Our clean product data is ready. Your work is to transfer it accurately, propose the branding and design, build the shopping experience with the team, and prove that customers can use it successfully. You must bring practical website implementation experience as well as marketing skills.

The January 1 launch takes priority within your first 90 days. Our accelerated launch milestones are:

By November 20, 2026 — Present branding and design proposals for Erica’s approval: visual direction, homepage, category and product page concepts, navigation, mobile layouts, and a dated implementation plan with owners and dependencies.

By December 15, 2026 — Complete the approved design and catalog migration in staging. Configure search, filters, product pages, quote and purchase paths, and measurement tools with the appropriate team members.

By December 30, 2026 — Complete testing and corrections. Submit a documented launch checklist, test results, and outstanding issues for Erica’s go-live approval.

January 1, 2027 — Launch the approved site with working customer journeys, verified inquiry and order routing, and a launch campaign ready to run.

Through the remainder of your first 90 days, monitor the live site, resolve issues, and use actual customer behavior and sales results to prioritize improvements.

What launch ready means

You will own the launch checklist and coordinate technical dependencies early. Before release, the team must verify:

Catalog accuracy: reconcile source and destination record counts; validate product identifiers, descriptions, sizes, materials, units of measure, weights, categories, and approved pricing. Resolve discrepancies with Funmi before publishing.

Customer experience: test navigation, product search and filters, mobile layouts, images, downloads, account access where applicable, and clear paths to request a quote or place an order.

Transactions and handoffs: test quote forms and notifications; validate applicable cart, checkout, payment, tax, freight, and order-confirmation flows with the responsible providers. Confirm that inquiries and orders reach the right Ace team.

Search and measurement: verify page titles, metadata, crawl and indexing settings, sitemap, redirects where needed, and analytics events for product views, inquiries, and purchases. Confirm that staging restrictions are removed at launch.

Operations: document how the team maintains the site, manages incoming inquiries and orders, and reports defects. Complete Erica’s final review before going live.

What you will own after launch

SEO and website conversion

Build keyword and competitor research around how contractors, fabricators, and purchasing teams actually search. Improve category pages, product pages, metadata, internal links, and useful educational content. Use Google Search Console to identify indexing and search issues; use GA4 to find where customers abandon inquiry or purchase paths. Maintain a prioritized improvement backlog and complete approved changes.

Social media and content

Own a practical publishing calendar for LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube. Create product features, application explainers, branch updates, customer stories with permission, and promotional content. Produce two YouTube videos per month and repurpose them into shorter clips and posts. Coordinate original footage with branch staff and verify technical claims with the product team.

Email and sales support

Build and execute two Mailchimp campaigns each week, on Monday and Thursday. Segment audiences, maintain contact lists, test links and mobile layouts, and direct customers to relevant products or quote forms. Keep line cards, branch marketing materials, and website promotions current. Work with sales to connect campaign inquiries to follow-up and results.

Brand consistency and execution

Keep messaging, visuals, product information, and calls to action consistent across websites, email, and social channels. Bring concepts and recommendations to Erica, obtain required approvals, and carry approved work through publication. Maintain a shared task board with deadlines, owners, blockers, and next actions.

How we will measure success

Send a concise performance report every Monday by 10:00 AM Pacific Time. Show what changed, what it produced, and what you will do next. Establish baselines and agree on numeric growth targets with Erica during onboarding.

Website revenue and orders by site, with campaign attribution where tracking supports it.

Qualified web inquiries and quote requests; quote-to-order conversion in partnership with sales.

Organic search clicks, relevant search visibility, and progress on indexing or technical issues.

Conversion rates and customer drop-off across product, inquiry, and purchase journeys.

Email clicks, qualified inquiries, and attributable sales; social engagement and referral traffic as supporting measures.

Launch milestones, completed improvements, unresolved blockers, and the next week’s priorities.

Pricing follows Ace’s approved matrix and management direction. You will improve how we present and sell products, coordinating pricing or source-data changes with the people responsible for them.

What you should bring

Examples of websites or e-commerce projects you helped launch, including your actual role in catalog migration, page setup, testing, and release.

Proven SEO and digital marketing work with results you can explain: starting point, actions, timeframe, and business impact.

Hands-on ability in website content management, GA4, Google Search Console, Mailchimp or a comparable platform, and SEO research tools.

Strong written English, visual design judgment, and the ability to create useful graphics and edit video.

Comfort working with structured product data and spreadsheets while protecting specifications, units of measure, and approved pricing.

Clear remote communication, dependable availability during the stated Pacific Time schedule, and the ability to organize several workstreams.

Practical use of AI tools, with human review for product accuracy, brand quality, and original thinking.

Experience with B2B distribution, industrial products, Shopify, ERP-connected storefronts, or INxSQL is a plus. You can learn our products; you should arrive knowing how to execute digital work and demonstrate results.

Why this opportunity

You will work directly with the leader responsible for digital growth, have a prepared catalog to build from, and see your work become a live sales channel. We value people who spot opportunities, propose a solution, follow through, and are candid when something needs attention.

An overview of this role

As a Senior Backend Engineer on Development Health, you'll help make the systems that engineering teams rely on more reliable, maintainable, and easier to extend. You'll build and improve the automation, tooling, and data that help teams spot problems early and ship with less friction.

As customer zero for GitLab, we support engineering workflows on GitLab's own product at scale. You'll use the product in demanding, real-world ways, surface the friction and gaps you find, and contribute to improvements that get built into the product for GitLab's customers.

You'll support work such as:

  • Health alerting and remediation routing for GitLab's core continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines
  • Flaky and slow test detection systems
  • Engineering analytics and reporting that engineering teams use to make decisions

What you’ll do

  • Own and evolve core Development Health systems, from design through production.

  • Use artificial intelligence (AI) agents and assistants to analyze issues and problem areas to help shape the team's product roadmap.
  • Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.

What you’ll bring

  • Substantial experience as a backend or tooling engineer, with a track record of owning production systems end to end.
  • Strong proficiency in Ruby, or the ability to become productive quickly.
  • Experience maintaining or modernizing legacy codebases safely.
  • Comfort with CI/CD systems, application programming interfaces (APIs), and automation at scale.
  • Independent problem-solving and clear, concise written communication: you spot problems early, raise risks proactively, and drive work to completion without close direction.
  • Experience writing automated unit and integration tests and taking part in collaborative code review.
  • Experience using AI coding assistants to speed up development while critically reviewing their output.
  • Optional experience: Rails; developer productivity, engineering analytics, or internal tooling; GitLab's product and open source contribution workflow; data pipelines or metrics reporting; or agent-based workflows that run in production.

About the team

Development Health is part of Developer Experience. Our work is mostly internal, and our customers are GitLab team members across an engineering organization of hundreds of engineers.

We're all-remote, asynchronous by default, and documentation-driven, in line with GitLab's values of collaboration, results, efficiency, diversity, inclusion and belonging, iteration, and transparency.

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off 
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave

35afecc81cb11ff0.description: Overview At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customers and partners needs and solve their challenges. Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve. Youll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care aboutlocally and globally. Come make an impact every day at Zebra. What We're Looking For Designs, develops, analyzes, and maintains software solutions for the organizations products and systems. Performs system integration of software and hardware to ensure throughput, consistency, and compliance with quality standards. Develops, validates, and tests software functionality and associated documentation. Work is reviewed for overall adequacy but allows for greater independence in day-to-day responsibilities. Follows established processes and contributes to improving existing methodologies. Essential Duties And Responsibilities Designs, develops, and tests software components as part of a larger project, ensuring alignment with project objectives and timelines. Creates and maintains documentation detailing specific software functionality and design specifications. Participates in code reviews and provides constructive feedback. Contributes to the development and testing of software solutions for various products analyzes results, and conducts root cause analysis to diagnose and resolve issues. Recommends and implements solutions to complex technical challenges, ensuring compliance with quality processes and standards. Modifies and enhances existing software, improving functionality, scalability, and performance to meet evolving business needs. Proactively seeks out opportunities to enhance performance and productivity by recommending new tools or methodologies. Demonstrates sound judgment to determine appropriate actions for software development and testing tasks. Assist less experienced staff with existing practices and processes. Builds productive working relationships within the team, across organizational units and with external customers. Occasionally interacts with inter-organizational and external stakeholders to address project-related needs or resolve issues. Job Requirements B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science or related engineering discipline. 0-1 years of relevant experience. Key Skills And Competencies Strong in data structures, algorithms, system design, and writing clean, maintainable, and highly optimized code across software development frameworks. Good interest in and exposure to modern Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and intelligent system architectures through projects, internships, or professional experience Good understanding of cloud-based architectures like GCP, containerized environments, CI/CD. Knowledge of both backend and modern front-end application interfaces. Practical understanding of the software development life cycle (SDLC), including Agile/Scrum methodologies, version control systems, debugging, and comprehensive system testing Proactive, self-motivated, and eager with strong communication and collaboration skills. Benefits We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success. Job Posting Statement To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra.com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department. AI Technology Statement Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. However, every decision regarding interviews and hiring is made by our dedicated team, because we believe people make the best decisions about people. For more on how we use technology in hiring and how we process applicant data, see our Zebra Privacy Policy. .

35b9f8a3c531b556.description: We are seeking a skilled Data Analyst to join our team in Maharashtra. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in data analysis and visualization, with expertise in tools such as Databricks and PowerBI. As a Data Analyst, you will be responsible for managing projects that involve data collection, analysis, and reporting. You will work closely with stakeholders to understand their data needs and provide actionable insights to drive business decisions. Key responsibilities include developing and maintaining dashboards, performing data analysis using Python, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure data integrity and accuracy. The successful candidate will possess strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate complex data findings in a clear and concise manner. Proficiency in project management is essential to effectively manage timelines and deliverables. If you are passionate about data and have the skills to turn data into meaningful insights, we encourage you to apply.

35edb2f3cfa06875.description: The Business Analyst role is pivotal in identifying and developing new business opportunities while analyzing current business processes to enhance efficiency and effectiveness. The ideal candidate will possess a strong analytical background, excellent communication skills, and a passion for driving business growth in a competitive market. This position is suitable for candidates with a range of experience in business analysis or business development across various industries. Key Responsibilities: - Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical specifications. - Conduct market research to identify new business opportunities and trends. - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement business solutions. - Develop and maintain business models to support strategic planning. - Prepare and present reports on business performance and growth opportunities. - Manage stakeholder relationships and ensure alignment with business objectives. - Assist in the development of business strategies and proposals. Required Skills: - Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, or a related field. - Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and make data-driven decisions. - Proficiency in business analysis tools and methodologies, such as SWOT analysis, PESTLE analysis, and financial modeling. - Experience with project management methodologies, such as Agile or Waterfall. - Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal. - Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI). - Knowledge of CRM software and business intelligence tools is a plus. - Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

Required Skills: - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. - Proficiency in business analysis methodologies and tools. - Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment. - Familiarity with data analysis and visualization tools is a plus.
